headline: Zero live Google ads for a brand with USD 112M raised - the search demand is all going somewhere else.
ad_intro: Third Wave Coffee is one of India's best-known specialty coffee brands, with USD 112M raised and a Series D reported in Aug 2026. Which is why this audit is unusual: Google Ads Transparency shows zero live creatives for its domain. This is verified on the Google side only - we did not confirm its Meta inventory in this pass, and we do not report what we did not verify. On the Google side, every 'coffee near me', 'cold brew', 'coffee beans online' and store-level search around its outlets is being answered by competitors.
ad_intelligence: 0 live creatives on Google Ads Transparency for thirdwavecoffeeroasters.com (region IN).
thirdwavecoffee.in 301-redirects to www.thirdwavecoffeeroasters.com; Shopify storefront (theme id 133405212742) with GTM installed and 8+ apps loaded - a fairly heavy stack for a beverage storefront.

USD 112M raised; Series D reported Aug 2026; brand-reported footprint around 100 outlets plus a coffee bean D2C line - i.e. both hyperlocal (store visits) and e-commerce (beans/subscriptions) demand exist.

Specialty coffee is the most searched premium F&B category in Bengaluru. Competitors (Blue Tokai, Third Wave, Sleepy Owl, Rage, plus hundreds of cafes) compete on brand search, 'near me' queries and bean subscriptions - all of which are Google/Meta purchase moments.
findings: Zero Google presence means store demand leaks daily: every 'coffee near me', 'best cafe Indiranagar', 'cold brew delivery' query in the cities where outlets exist is being answered without you. Local store campaigns are the cheapest walk-in acquisition channel available to a cafe chain.

Bean subscriptions are a Google/Meta purchase: the D2C bean line competes with Blue Tokai et al, who buy category search. Coffee beans are a repeat subscription purchase - exactly the profile that paid search + retargeting serves best.

Heavy Shopify stack, no paid layer: 8+ apps and a Shopify theme that is several versions old creates a slow, app-heavy storefront - and speed multiplies every paid campaign you run. Fix the storefront weight before scaling spend.
Not verified: Meta. Our audit verifies what it can prove. Google is verified at zero; a Meta check is the first step of implementation. We will not claim data we have not seen.
competitors: Buy 'coffee beans online' and 'cold brew' terms; match their subscription mechanics.
Third Wave's cafe footprint is a trust advantage - convert store visitors into subscribers.
Hyperlocal presence and Google Business Profile visibility.
Local store-ad campaigns plus review velocity per outlet.
wins: Launch per-store radius campaigns for the top 10 Bengaluru outlets with a first-visit offer, measured on store visits - the cheapest walk-in channel a cafe chain can buy.
Buy category search ('coffee beans online', 'cold brew', 'single origin coffee') and retarget every store visitor and bean buyer into a monthly subscription with free shipping.
Audit the 8+ Shopify apps and old theme, remove unused scripts, and pass Core Web Vitals before scaling paid - speed multiplies every rupee of paid traffic.
impact: Store walk-ins and bean orders captured
